I enjoy slow burners but this one is too slow and most of the time uneventful. With three major actors playing in the same movie, you would expect to be blown away but the script is poorly written to the point that you cannot wait for this disappointment to be over. What a waste of great actors. Worth watching on a rainy day.

Rami Malek’s mouth is so fucked up after Bohemian Rhapsody that I’m not totally sure if it’s cool for me to make fun of it. I really want to, though. Just feels like a thing where in two years he might reveal that he was hiding a rock in there for a sad reason and I’ll have to go back and turn comments for this review off.
Denzel shouting, “your dick is as hard as chinese arithmetic, why is that, huh!?” would have caused audiences to go absolutely nuts in 1997, the year I assume this was supposed to be released
